verdict.rationale: Paddle's own documentation says its first-party MCP server lets agents "process customer refunds", and that server's execute tool chains Paddle API calls, so Paddle does offer a refund capability through an API-backed interface. The pack never documents a refund endpoint, the dashboard refund flow, or the difference between full and partial refunds; only reconciliation 'adjustments' are mentioned. Missing for 10: documented refund/adjustment API endpoint, dashboard refund workflow, explicit full vs. partial refund support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can issue full or partial refunds from both the dashboard and the API

citations.quote: Build pricing models, investigate failed payments, integrate Paddle features, or process customer refunds — all in natural language.
Runs a JavaScript async function that chains one or more Paddle API calls in a single invocation
Payout reconciliation reports help you reconcile payouts to transactions and adjustments to understand how your payout amounts are calculated
